E1115

`Shared.new(…)` is the retired shared-cell constructor.

What

`Shared.new(…)` is the retired shared-cell constructor.

Why

D-CONC-SHARE1=A gives shared state one construction word, so every shared cell reads the same on the page.

Fix

Write `shared <value>` instead of `Shared.new(<value>)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1115: tests/ui/shared_retired_constructor.stderr.

 Fix: write `shared <value>` instead of `Shared.new(<value>)`.
